projection_cluster.engine: unchanged ace3_awq_w4a16_projection_engine with native asymmetric G128 AWQ semantics

rope.pairing: For each 64-element head, pair x[p] with x[p+32] for p in [0,31].
rope.operation_rounding: Each multiply rounds to binary16 RNE before the binary16 RNE add.
rope.coefficient_interface: cos and sin are externally supplied binary16 values indexed by position and pair; authenticated vectors use Qwen theta=1000000 with float32 coefficient generation followed by binary16 conversion.
rope.nonfinite: Any non-finite data or coefficient input returns positive-zero outputs and invalid_operand=1.
rope.finite_overflow: Each finite multiply or add saturates to signed maximum finite binary16 and raises saturation.
rope.protocol: One ready-valid pair enters and one ready-valid rotated pair exits; output data, metadata, and status remain stable under backpressure.
rope.clear_reset: Active-low asynchronous reset and active-high synchronous clear abort any pending output.

kv_cache.index_order: cache_slot, position, KV head, head dimension
kv_cache.storage: Separate synchronous-write K and V arrays with validity metadata; data arrays are not reset.
kv_cache.read: Accepted reads produce a retained response with hit status; misses return positive-zero K and V.
kv_cache.same_cycle: A simultaneous read and write to the same address is write-through.
kv_cache.overwrite: A later accepted write replaces both K and V at exactly one index.
kv_cache.clear_reset: Reset and clear invalidate all entries and abort a pending response without claiming zeroed SRAM data.

verification_boundary.official_derived: RoPE operands and cache values are deterministic selections from hash-authenticated layer-0 q_proj FP16 scale samples, not captured runtime Q/K/V activations.
excluded: synthesis, timing, area, power, FPGA, silicon, or dialogue
